name: Love Songs ♪ ADV: Futaba Riho 19-sai ~Fuyu~
original_name: LoveSongs♪アドベンチャー 双葉理保19歳〜冬〜
source:
Riho graduates from high school and lives a life of a progressive girl paying enough attention both to love and work. Currently she is a radio star presenting consultation program. She is asked to give lectures at a high school. Her heartful story of tears and laughs begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高中毕业后，理保成为了一名积极进取的女孩，兼顾着恋爱与工作。如今，她是主持咨询节目的电台明星，又受邀到一所高中演讲。一段笑中带泪、温暖人心的故事就此开始。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
